component.name: Proton Drive CLI
component.summary: Proton Drive command-line client, packaged as an AppImage

description.p: Unofficial AppImage packaging of the official Proton Drive CLI published by Proton AG. The binary inside is the unmodified upstream linux build, verified against the SHA-512 checksum published on proton.me before it is packaged.

Proton Drive CLI supports authentication, filesystem operations (upload, download, sync-style moves), sharing and invitations, albums and photos, and Google Takeout import. Run it with --help for the full command list.
